summary: Full backend + frontend testing of ForestWatch deforestation monitoring MVP. All 16 pytest backend tests passed (auth register/login/me/refresh/logout, alerts list/filter/stats, modules list/get/not-found, health) and all UI flows passed (login, register, dashboard stats, Leaflet map with 20 alert circles + severity filter, modules page lists all 6 modules, sidebar nav, logout, protected-route redirect).

minor.issue: Returns HTTP 200 with {detail, code:'not_found'} instead of a proper 404 status. Functionally identifiable but not RESTful.

issues: Alerts are rendered as Leaflet CircleMarkers (SVG). They display correctly with proper colors/sizes; just noting if HTML markers with icons were intended, that is not the current implementation.

action_items: (Optional) Return HTTP 404 from GET /api/modules/{name} when module not found instead of 200 with not_found payload.
critical_code_review_comments: Cookies use secure=true + samesite=none, which is correct for cross-origin httpOnly auth over HTTPS (preview URL is HTTPS) - works as expected.

CORS_ORIGINS='*' is permissive; with allow_credentials=True some browsers reject wildcard. Currently works because the response uses the request Origin via Starlette CORS implementation, but recommend setting explicit origin = FRONTEND_URL for production.
auth_routes._set_auth_cookies is duplicated logic in /refresh endpoint - minor DRY violation.
module_routes returns 200 for 'not found' modules; should use HTTPException(404).
All endpoints async, MongoDB _id properly excluded (verified via response inspection).
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 20 demo alerts and admin user on startup. Verified: GET /api/alerts returned 20 items, stats by_severity = {low:5, medium:5, high:6, critical:4}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL+/api. Auth uses httpOnly cookies (access_token, refresh_token) - use requests.Session() or axios withCredentials. Seeded admin: admin@forestwatch.io / ForestAdmin2026!. All testids match request: login-{email,password,submit}, register-{email,name,password,submit}, dashboard-page, map-page, map-filter-panel, nav-{dashboard,map,modules}, logout-btn. backend_test.py is reusable - run via: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml.
